integrity_statement: The complete proof and reproducible standard-library exact checker are included. Computational verification is finite and is not presented as a substitute for the all-size proof. Historical originality is evaluated against identified inspected primary texts with explicit residual risks. No independent audit or external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact for standard binary Kingman genealogies under unit pairwise merger rates and independent clocks. The mutation corollary additionally assumes the independent infinite-sites Poisson mutation model. This supplies mixed second moments, not an entire joint distribution, and does not treat multiple mergers, demographic changes, or correlations between merger times and shapes. Historical literature coverage may be incomplete.
title: Levelwise cherry–doubleton association in Kingman's coalescent
